description: Refactor step M1, class A (docs/plans/codebase-refactor.md §6.4): cmd/server's settings, logging and request-body helpers leave main.go for config.go, logging.go and http.go. The comment above envOr in main.go, which introduces the settings helpers, becomes config.go's header; declmove does not move a free-floating comment, so the commit deletes it from main.go. Preview with: go run ./internal/tools/declmove -n -spec internal/tools/declmove/specs/M1.json
